about: primary contests of 2020 in North Carolina, in the layout of plan/PLAN.md section 3 with the fields data/README.md adds (D3). Built by pipeline/local_ncsbe.py from pipeline/intake/ncsbe.py's cache.

party_codes.other codes: the source's own three-letter code, in party and party_code; its layout files give no codebook

ncsbe.name: North Carolina State Board of Elections, precinct results by contest (results_pct files of the public download site's ENRS folder)
ncsbe.licence: public records under N.C. Gen. Stat. 132-1, as the site's ReadMe_PUBLIC_DATA.txt says; no licence printed
ncsbe.note: the state's own certified counts, by county, precinct and choice, added up to the contest by pipeline/intake/ncsbe.py; files read: 2020-03-03 (results_pct_20200303.zip, sha256 8efe5d16c2dd), 2020-06-23 (results_pct_20200623.zip, sha256 066a44b29b49)
